The Runbook.description: A fortnightly engineering show on incident.io's YouTube channel.

episodes.episodeTitle: Building video games in React with Joe Hart
episodes.summary: I chatted about rebuilding Age of Empires 2 in React, and what making games teaches you about the web.

episodes.episodeTitle: A million interns who never learn
episodes.summary: Lisa and I dig into what it really means to work alongside AI agents that never remember yesterday.

episodes.episodeTitle: We break our own systems on purpose
episodes.summary: Leo explains why we deliberately break our own systems, and what we learn every time we do.

episodes.episodeTitle: Your AI demo works. Now comes the hard part.
episodes.summary: Getting an AI feature to demo well is easy. Getting it to production is the hard part.
